title: Add Pollination_chatbot to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollination_chatbot](https://pollinations-chatbot.vercel.app) to image
- Ek simple aur friendly AI chatbot jo Pollinations ke text generation API (openai, mistral, gemini models) se power hota hai. Users apni Pollinations account se secure "Login with Pollinations" (BYOP a

Fixes #14739

gist.headline: A friendly chat flower
gist.blurb: Pollination_chatbot has joined the garden: a simple, friendly chat app powered by Pollinations text models. Bring a Pollinations account and let openai, mistral, and gemini do the talking.
gist.summary: Added Pollination_chatbot to the app registry, giving users a friendly chatbot powered by Pollinations text generation models including OpenAI, Mistral, and Gemini with Login with Pollinations support.
gist.impact: Users can now discover and use Pollination_chatbot as a secure Pollinations-powered chat interface for conversations across several text-model providers.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli welcoming a small friendly chatbot app into a cozy garden hackerspace: a retro CRT terminal shows rounded chat bubbles while model-themed flowers bloom around it. Polli should wear tiny headset headphones and warmly help the eager Monitor Robot connect the chat screen, representing the app's multi-model conversation and Pollinations login.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy garden hackerspace scene where the cute pixel art bee mascot, with a tiny headset, warmly helps a chunky CRT-monitor robot open a friendly chatbot window with simple pixel chat bubbles; nearby flower pots grow little labels reading “OpenAI”, “Mistral”, and “Gemini” around a prominently glowing lime green (#ecf874) login key. The bee has a yellow body with dark brown stripes, black antennae and oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small smile, and rounded light-blue translucent wings; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow, emotionally warm.
